wiki.title: Brad Farrin
wiki.extract: Bradlee Thomas Farrin (born 1964) is an American politician from Maine. Farrin, a Republican, was first elected to the Maine House of Representatives in 2014 (District 111). Re-elected in 2016, Farrin won election to the Maine Senate in 2018 (District 3). He is a resident of Norridgewock, Maine and represents a largely rural district covering Somerset County, Maine.
